_doc: One real client story = one page, forever. Marcus checks this before assigning story.is_real_client. Never relocate a real client to a city they don't live in.

gallagher-family.note: Real clients. Fabian confirmed on 2026-09-23 that Richard and Elizabeth Gallagher are real clients who gave permission to be portrayed in commercials and ads. The IMAGERY is still Higgsfield-rendered rather than photographed, which is a production fact, not a verification gap — the people and the project are real, the footage is a dramatisation of their actual job. Keep those two separate: naming them as clients is now cleared; presenting rendered footage as documentary photography is not, and never was.
